title: 第六十七章 林萧惨败第六十六章 冰皇后科拿的敲打
content_zh:
许久不见班吉拉，林萧发现班吉拉壮实了不少，领悟本源后浑身铠甲闪耀着灰色光芒，走动之下还能带起地面晃动，宛如地震一般。
“班~”几个月不见，班吉拉亲昵的用头在林萧身上磨蹭，用舌头在他脸上不停的舔，似乎想把这段时间的jimo找回。
又免费洗了一把脸，林萧欢喜的抱着班吉拉，用手轻轻抚摸它深绿而厚实的盔甲，淡淡的灰色光芒让林萧的手微微颤动。
场地边上，夏伯眼里闪过一丝羡慕，笑骂道：“臭小子，这不是刺激我老人家吗？战斗开始了，我最先出场的伙伴是九尾。”
和林萧的亲密被夏伯打断，班吉拉不满的瞪了夏伯一眼，拍拍自己的胸膛站到炎帝和巨大快龙身边。
“九尾？那么快龙，第一场由你来打好了。”林萧对巨大快龙说道。
“呜~”巨大快龙，清鸣一声，走进场地，居高临下的望着九尾，做出战斗姿态。
面对比自己巨大的快龙，夏伯的九尾毫不胆怯，坐在地上优雅的摆动自己九条长长的尾巴。如果说在小精灵里评选绅士的话，九尾毫无疑问当选头号种子。
年纪虽然大了，不过夏伯的心可不老，“既然如此，我就不客气了，九尾喷射火焰！”
得到指令的九尾喷出一道巨大的火柱，特别是在火山场地这种地方，火焰的温度起码会提升百分之二十。
“快龙，水炮迎接！”林萧对快龙说道。
“呜~”巨大快龙毫不逊色的喷出一股水桶般粗的水柱和九尾的火焰撞击在一起。
水与火的碰撞，最后发出爆炸，掀起了无数水蒸气，遍布全场，将夏伯和林萧的视线都遮挡住。
因为爆炸，巨大快龙和九尾纷纷退后两步，弥漫的雾气瞬间笼罩住它们。
被雾气挡住眼睛，看不到里面情况，林萧对巨大快龙喊道：“快龙，打雷！”这样一来快龙自己也会被雷电击中，但是林萧相信巨大快龙的体力足以支撑到九尾倒下，论体力林萧的小精灵里没有能和巨大快龙相提并论的存在，就算是联盟公认体力最好幸福蛋也不行。
“轰隆！”
巨大的闪电，从天而降，将雾水中的巨大快龙、九尾一起笼罩。
“呜~~”被自己的绝招命中，巨大快龙发出痛苦的shenyin。
“嘿嘿！小子，你以为我的九尾那么好欺负？”夏伯嘿嘿一笑。
林萧定睛一看，同样笼罩在雷电里的九尾身上围着一个淡蓝色的光圈，阻止闪电的侵入。

“该死！这只九尾竟然会念力。虽然攻击不足，但至少防御足够。”林萧暗骂一声，对巨大快龙道：“快龙飞起来，用烈暴风将雾水吹开。”九尾的嗅觉很敏锐，在雾气中对快龙不利。
快龙飞上半空，用翅膀扇出一个小型龙卷风将雾水吹散，恢复本来的样子。
“你的快龙很不错，”夏伯对巨大快龙发出赞叹，“这应该是你在正辉灯塔那里收服超古代快龙吧？”
“是它，没错。”林萧点头说道。
“当初不少人打它的主意呢，连我都想把它抢过来。”说到这里，夏伯露出一丝猥琐的笑容，“哎~要是我有一只母快龙就好了，一定会让它帮忙配个种.....”
为老不尊，绝对是这样，林萧无语的望着夏伯，这种话你也能说出口？
“哼！”坐在场边的科拿冷哼一声，顿时让夏伯打了个寒颤。
“哎~都是你，好端端的干嘛找我说这些，害得老头子我又被误会了吧！”夏伯一推四五六，把责任全都兜在林萧的头上。
战斗继续，夏伯对九尾喊道：“九尾，火焰漩涡，”
在高温的加持下，火焰漩涡足足扩大了一圈，威力十足。
“快龙，急冻光线。”林萧大喊道。
急冻光线扫过的地方冻起一层厚厚的冰，将火焰漩涡挡在外面，但坚冰很快融化，荡起大量的水雾。
content_en:
After not seeing Bangila for a long time, Lin Xiao found that Bangila had become much stronger. After realizing the origin, his armor was shining with gray light. When he walked, he could make the ground shake, like an earthquake.
"Ban~" After not seeing each other for several months, Banjila rubbed her head against Lin Xiao's body affectionately and licked his face with her tongue, as if she wanted to get back the jimo she had during this period.
After washing his face for free, Lin Xiao happily hugged Bangila and gently touched its dark green and thick armor with his hands. The faint gray light made Lin Xiao's hands tremble slightly.
At the edge of the field, Xia Bo's eyes flashed with envy, and he laughed and cursed: "You brat, isn't this irritating my old man? The battle has begun, and my first partner is Kyuubi."
The intimacy with Lin Xiao was interrupted by Xia Bo. Bangila glared at Xia Bo dissatisfiedly, patted his chest and stood next to Yan Emperor and the giant dragon.
"Nine-tails? Then Kuailong, it's up to you to fight the first game." Lin Xiao said to the huge Kuailong.
"Woo~" The giant fast dragon let out a clear cry and walked into the venue. It looked down at Nine Tails and made a fighting stance.
Facing the dragon that was bigger than him, Xia Bo's nine tails were not timid. He sat on the ground and swung his nine long tails gracefully. If we were to select gentlemen among elves, Kyuubi would undoubtedly be the top seed.
Although he is old, Uncle Xia's heart is not old. "In that case, I won't be polite. The nine tails will spray flames!"
After receiving the order, Nine-Tails spewed out a huge pillar of fire. Especially in a place like a volcano, the temperature of the flames would increase by at least 20%.
"Kuai Long, welcome with water cannons!" Lin Xiao said to Kuai Long.
"Woo~" The huge dragon sprayed out a water column as thick as a bucket and collided with the flames of the nine tails.
The collision of water and fire finally exploded, setting off countless water vapors that spread all over the place, blocking the sight of Xia Bo and Lin Xiao.
Because of the explosion, the giant dragon and nine tails took two steps back, and the diffuse fog instantly enveloped them.
His eyes were blocked by the mist and he couldn't see what was going on inside. Lin Xiao shouted to the giant dragon, "Kailong, thunder!" In this way, the dragon himself would be hit by lightning, but Lin Xiao believed that the strength of the giant dragon was enough to sustain the Nine-Tails when it fell. In terms of physical strength, none of Lin Xiao's elves could compare with the giant dragon, not even the Happy Egg, which was recognized by the alliance as having the best physical strength.
"Boom!"
Huge lightning fell from the sky, covering the huge dragon and nine tails in the mist.
"Woo~~" Being hit by his own special move, the huge dragon let out a painful shenyin.
"Hey! Boy, do you think my Kyuubi is so easy to bully?" Xia Bo chuckled.
Lin Xiao took a closer look and saw that the nine tails, which were also shrouded in thunder and lightning, had a light blue circle around them, preventing the intrusion of lightning.
"Damn it! This Nine-Tails actually knows telekinesis. Although the attack is insufficient, at least the defense is sufficient." Lin Xiao cursed secretly and said to the huge Kuailong: "The Kuailong flew up and blew the fog away with the violent wind." The Nine-Tails' sense of smell is very keen, and it is not good for the Kuailong in the fog.
Kuailong flew into the air and used its wings to create a small tornado to blow away the fog and return to its original appearance.
"Your dragon is very good," Xia Bo praised the huge dragon. "This should be the super ancient dragon you conquered at Zhenghui Lighthouse, right?"
"That's it, that's right." Lin Xiao nodded and said.
"Many people were interested in it at the beginning, and even I wanted to snatch it away." At this point, Xia Bo showed a sly smile, "Hey~ if only I had a female dragon, I would definitely let her help breed..."
Being disrespectful to an elder is definitely like this. Lin Xiao looked at Uncle Xia speechlessly. Can you say such a thing?
"Hmph!" Ke Na, who was sitting on the sidelines, snorted coldly, which immediately made Xia Bo shiver.
"Hey~ It's all you, so goodWhy did you come to me to tell me this? I must have caused the old man to be misunderstood again! "Xia Bo pushed four, five, six, and put all the responsibility on Lin Xiao's head.
The battle continued, and Xia Bo shouted to Jiuwei: "Nine tails, flame vortex,"
Under the blessing of high temperature, the flame vortex expanded in a full circle and was full of power.
"Kuailong, freezing light. "Lin Xiao shouted.
A thick layer of ice froze where the freezing light swept, blocking the flame vortex, but the ice quickly melted, creating a large amount of water mist.
